scope: Stdlib/retained artifact source review only; no Torch, training, GPU, or model execution.

source_findings.claim: Constant noise removes learner age/horizon dependence from noise amplitude; both public helpers return configured std before reading completed_steps/total_steps. RP10 selects input0/output.029.
Public immutable Recipe validates and checkpoints noise_policy; continuous precision requires total_stepsNone. Old schedule fields remain serialized but are unused by the declared trainer path.

No target identity, evaluation horizon, target modes, thresholds or change times are inputs to learner update/controller. Reversible RP5 scales depend on internal gap/activity state; same precision source as predecessor.

Full public serial scope wraps joint field construction and both higher-order backward passes. Tensor real/Greal inputs are frozen by host; transaction restores optimizer/EMA/buffers/private/global RNG before corrector, accepts one completed count, observes precision once, and rolls back saved trainer checkpoint on failure.

Secant policy retains base-gradient native Adam moments and applies existing two-field damping. Unchanged legacy solver/particle helpers remain in source but selectors are secant_resolvent; no particle RNG allocated.

Checkpoint contains full recipe (including noise policy), precision reference/state, optimizer native/controller state, accepted count, streams and global RNG; load validates recipe/execution state before live mutation.

Canonical tiny host preserves prior-first CUDA initialization and shared realD/latentD/latentG/realG cursor protocol. Existing live/EMA output noise uses isolated global402+step and latent9. All1200 batch rows independently match RP5.

Image host preserves frozen CPU G/D/prior then CUDA construction; shared CUDA real/latent protocol; all32 prior row enumeration; isolated output-noise seed402+step+1901; original24 checks/suffix5. Output amplitude is now.029 at all observations, as declared.

regression.initial_failure_reason: Noise helper test incorrectly combined continuous_precision=rp5 with finite total_steps; validation correctly rejected each of six age cases. Corrected test uses continuous precision only when horizon is None; package rule was retained.
regression.source_scope: Exact test source was not in frozen run/package ZIP. Later active test snapshot is supplemental only (owner was already preparing RP11).

quality_blocker: Completed tiny0/24 and intensity4/24suffix1 reject RP10 under its unchanged frozen gate; own ring/long qualification not run.

api_limits.reason: Standalone learning_rate_scales and scale_learning_rates still use finite total_steps; declared trainer internally bypasses them for continuous precision. Custom component hosts cannot reuse the full controller/transaction through those helpers.
GANTrainer explicitly only accepts scalar unconditional particle-prior/no-encoder host. Conditional, auxiliary-loss and multiple-optimizer hosts still lack earned reusable full-transaction binding.

limitations: No own ring, long, stationary, repeated changes, differing-budget trained prefix or cross-process CUDA replay inherited from predecessors.
Eager parameter-device Adam counters are explicit candidate formulation; exact released supporting comparator uses ordinary lazy CPU counters.
Initial broad JSON receipts match model hashes but omit per-private-stream hashes; raw checkpoint private RNG equality was not newly verified for RP10.
Removed input-noise and initial full output-noise draws intentionally change private training-noise cursor progression.
Historical image prior_weight.05 differs from candidate-wide prior_reg0; this is a declared learner regularization setting, not an omitted task objective.
